nodes.label: Layered Context
nodes.rationale: Global (~/.config/agent/) composes with project (.agent/); higher layers override lower ones, never the reverse.

nodes.label: Phase Model
nodes.rationale: Exactly one phase at a time; phase-specific rules live in .agent/phases/{phase}.md only — no gates in JSON, no personas.

nodes.label: Codebase Check
nodes.rationale: Phase A: refresh memory/codebase-snapshot.md; Phase B: run config.check.

nodes.label: Branch Guard
nodes.rationale: Stop edits on protected default branch unless hotfix opt-in; resolve name from config.defaultBranch, origin/HEAD, or main.

nodes.label: Root Cause Principle
nodes.rationale: Fix causes not appearances; forbidden without opt-in: copy-paste error silencing, widened catches, parallel bypass paths.

nodes.label: Clean Code → Clean Repo → Clean Product
nodes.rationale: Work in order: local change respects patterns; repo stays consistent; product coherent with PRD and ARCHITECTURE.
nodes.norm_label: clean code → clean repo → clean product

nodes.label: No LLM in Install Tooling
nodes.rationale: Install scripts only copy/transform filesystem templates; all judgment stays in the IDE agent.

nodes.label: Platforms Not in config.json
nodes.rationale: Do not put platform/platforms in committed .agent/config.json; IDE list lives in ~/.config/agent/platforms.json from /daf-onboard.
